Wallet Link

Link a second app with your Raptor Cash wallet using OTP — no API key needed.

Wallet Link is a premium feature

Available on the Developer (₹399) and Gold (₹199) plans. Upgrade to link a second app with your main wallet.

Wallet Link DirectW
Setting up…
One special link. Paste it in any app, product or checkout. Payments are taken from your Raptor Cash wallet and validated credits land in it, with instant replies. No OTP and no waiting.
Firebase rules update needed. Copy the "Firebase Rules" box below, publish it, then reopen this page.

Instant Wallet
Max per payment
How it works
  1. Copy the link above, or the ready code below, and paste it once into your other app or product page.
  2. Call QPInstantWallet.pay(amount, "item name") on your Buy button. The amount is deducted from your wallet instantly and the reply comes back in a second.
  3. Call QPInstantWallet.credit(amount) after you validate a payment. The money is added to your wallet instantly.
  4. Keep the RaptorPay app open on one device so requests can be approved in real time. Every payment appears in Transactions and Notifications.
  5. Treat the link like a password. If it leaks, press New link and the old one stops working immediately.

Your Raptor API Key

This key identifies YOUR RaptorPay account when your own website, app, or server calls RaptorPay. Keep it private — anyone with this key can create payment orders billed to your account.

Created —
Regenerating instantly disables the old key — update it everywhere you've used it.
Quick Start

Full step-by-step guides for HTML/JS, PHP, and Java are in API Integration, right below Raptor API in the sidebar. Short version:

  1. Create an order — POST /api/developer/create-order with { quick_api, amount, title }
  2. Send the customer to the payment_url you get back
  3. Poll GET /api/developer/order-status/:orderId (same key) until status is success or failed, and show your own success/failure UI

Gateway Mode

Applies to your whole account — both your Raptor API and every payment link. Switch to Test Mode to try your integration end-to-end with zero real money involved: customers get RaptorPay's own simulator (test.html) instead of a real UPI checkout, and you get the same success/failed/cancelled notifications you'd get for real, without a rupee moving.

You're in Test Mode right now — every customer using your payment links or Raptor API sees the simulator, not a real checkout. Switch back to Live before accepting real payments.

API Integration

Accept RaptorPay payments on your own website or app — step by step.

How it works
  1. Copy your Raptor API key from Developer Portal → Raptor API. Keep it on your server — never put it in public code.
  2. Create an order: POST /api/developer/create-order with { quick_api, amount, title }.
  3. Send your customer to the payment_url you get back — they pay on RaptorPay.
  4. Check the result: GET /api/developer/order-status/:orderId?quick_api=YOUR_KEY until the status is success or failed, then show your own success / failure screen.
Tip: switch to Test Mode (Raptor API → Gateway Mode) to try the whole flow without real money.
